purpose: Canonical per-edit training record supporting SFT and high-quality same-prompt preference/DPO data.
rules: One independent editorial decision per file.
Never invent a rejected candidate for historical accepted edits.
For future preference data, save every candidate verbatim before author selection.
Preference candidates must answer the same prompt with the same repository context.
Record the author's actual selection source.
An accepted revision may be SFT-eligible and, when a real alternative exists, preference-eligible too.
Keep no-change as a valid candidate to teach editorial restraint.
